implementation_notes: Plain JavaScript dispatches structurally, so LSP/ISP are conventions that only tooling can enforce. Put the contracts in JSDoc `@typedef` plus runtime validation (e.g. zod) at module boundaries, inject collaborators as function parameters, and use ES modules to keep each reason to change in its own file.
idiom_name: JSDoc typedef + runtime schema validation + parameter injection
pitfalls: Monkey-patching prototypes of imported objects breaks substitutability for every consumer at once.
Relying on JSDoc alone: nothing enforces the contract at runtime or in CI without a type-check step.
Deeply nested imports create hidden coupling that no interface can express.
